title: Koko Head Hike with Pickup and Drop-off
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Witness the beauty of the island as you hike to the top of a stunning crater during golden hour. This adventure involves climbing 1,048 stairs to reach one of the premier viewpoints for breathtaking sunset views. With included pick-up and drop-off, your journey begins seamlessly with guidance from an expert. Ideal for outdoor enthusiasts looking for a memorable experience in nature.

- Climb 1,048 stairs to a breathtaking crater viewpoint
- Experience stunning sunset views over the island
- Includes convenient pick-up and drop-off service
- Perfect for outdoor enthusiasts and adventure seekers
